definitions.explanation: eating food while standing, typically at a counter or stall; also refers to establishments where customers eat standing up

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{食|ぐ}いそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had stand-up soba at the station.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Stand-up eating is convenient when you're short on time.
I made do with a quick stand-up breakfast.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ (to eat - rough) → eating while standing

CULTURAL NOTE:
{立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い shops, especially soba and udon counters at train stations, serve quick, cheap meals to commuters. Eating while walking in public is often frowned on, but eating standing up at such a shop is completely normal.

TYPES:
- {立|た}ち{食|ぐ}いそば (stand-up soba shop)
- {立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ (stand-up udon shop)
- {立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い{寿司|ずし} (stand-up sushi)
